title: Ted Nelson demonstrates Xanadu Space
summary: Ted Nelson demonstrates Xanadu Space, his software for representing hypertext in three-dimensional space with linked, referenced content fragments.
why: Recommended as the shortest way to grasp Nelson's idea of referential content and how the web could have been different.

quote.text: Too many great talks to mention, but if I had to pick one it would be Ted Nelson's few minutes of demonstration of Xanadu.
